sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

This intuitive system allows for smooth and precise movements, making it easy to swing from vine to vine, climb trees, and leap across gaps. But don't be fooled - the game also features a unique physics-based system, where your every movement and action mimics the natural agility of a gorilla.

As you progress through the game, you'll encounter a variety of environments, ranging from dense forest canopies to towering cliffs and ancient ruins.
